title: Multilingual Political Views of Large Language Models: Identification and Steering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using the Political Compass Test (PCT) with paraphrased prompts across 14 languages to map responses onto economic (left-right) and social (libertarian-authoritarian) axes, as well as testing test-time activation interventions to steer models toward liberal or conservative outputs.
Comparing the political orientations (PCT scores) elicited from language models when prompted in 14 different languages to identify systematic, language-induced shifts in ideological behavior.
